_meta.name: mmm_bayes_geo
_meta.description: Geo-hierarchical Bayesian media-mix model over a two-market weekly panel: params.geo names the market field, so the east and west series (104 weeks each, one row per market and week) fit one model instead of being refused as duplicate_time. Each channel's ROI and adstock decay are partially pooled across the markets (non-centred: a market's value is the population mu shifted by tau times its own offset, on the log-ROI and logit-decay scales), while the Hill curves, the price and promo controls and the noise are shared and each market keeps its own intercept. The chains are kept short for a quick run (2 chains of 100 warmup + 100 draws, so the fit carries diagnostic warnings; drop them for the 4 × (1000 + 1000) default), rng_seed pins the draws and holdout_from 92 holds each market's last 13 weeks out of the likelihood. The coefficient table names the population terms as tv / decay:tv, each market's as tv[east] / decay:tv[east] and the pooling scales as tau:tv / tau:decay:tv; outputs.roi / mroi / contribution give the all-market figure under tv (summed contribution over summed spend) beside tv[east] and tv[west], and outputs.hierarchy the population mu and tau of every pooled term.
